pages.title: Dipole Winding
pages.text: Superconducting cable wound into a saddle-shaped coil. Its magnetic field runs straight across the beam pipe and bends charged particles into a circle, as in every synchrotron. It is cold, heavy and slightly springy, frosted along its windings.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To steer particles around a ring I needed a uniform bending field. In the Metamaterial Weaver I wound a Superconducting Coil over Neutronium Plate and metamaterial into a saddle, cooled in helium. A derelict station had one too.
